verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's hybrid search docs state it provides native reranking with managed models alongside server-side RRF fusion, which is a built-in, first-party reranking capability. The query docs also support late-interaction (ColBERT-style) multi-vector ranking. The evidence is a single brief mention, though. missing for 10: details on which reranking models are offered and how reranking is configured in the query API, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that managed reranking works.
